protection: Each of the 5 participants adds a slice of the noise, and the slices are added up inside the secure sum. One message alone carries far too little noise; the protection comes from the sum.

Training records are protected, at the stated budget, from the server and from anyone who sees a model, as long as at most 1 of the participants pool what they know with the server and at most 0 are missing from a sum. The table in this report shows the budget for other numbers.
The same budget holds against any one participant, with or without the server.
The server receives every message hidden under masks that only cancel in the sum. It can read the sum of all messages and no single one, provided it passes the participants' public keys on unchanged.
If a participant's message is missing, the sum cannot be opened, the model does not move, and the round still counts against the budget of those who sent one.
